author: Anwesh Ajitabh Dash
notes: Shipped AeroLaminate Pro material database. Mean/typical values, NOT design allowables. Each property carries status and source.

references.WWFE98: Soden P.D., Hinton M.J., Kaddour A.S. (1998) Lamina properties, lay-up configurations and loading conditions for a range of fibre-reinforced composite laminates. Compos. Sci. Technol. 58(7):1011-1022. doi:10.1016/S0266-3538(98)00078-5
references.CAM07: Camanho P.P., Maimi P., Davila C.G. (2007) Prediction of size effects in notched laminates using continuum damage mechanics. Compos. Sci. Technol. 67:2715-2727. doi:10.1016/j.compscitech.2007.02.005
references.NCAMP5320: NCAMP CAM-RP-2013-002 Rev A (2017) Cycom 5320-1 T650 Unitape Qualification Material Property Data Report; NCP-RP-2013-001 Rev A (statistical analysis); NMS 532/5 Rev A.
references.TH80: Tsai S.W., Hahn H.T. (1980) Introduction to Composite Materials. Technomic. Reproduced in Kaw A.K. (2006) Mechanics of Composite Materials, 2nd ed., CRC, Table 2.1.
references.ROM: Rule-of-mixtures estimate computed for AeroLaminate Pro; see note.
references.ARX2607: arXiv:2607.07977 (2026), 'A Puck-informed mode-resolved phase-field fatigue framework for unidirectional composites', Table 1 (IM7/8552 card; the paper calls it a numerical demonstration card and does not state its origin). Secondary source.
references.LSD-T300: lsdyna-online.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/c2.pdf, uncited material table row 'Carbon T300/Epoxy 5208'. Secondary source.
references.NMS532: NCAMP NMS 532/5 Rev A (17 Apr 2017), material specification for Cycom 5320-1 T650 unitape: acceptance requirements, not property values.
references.NCAMP8552: NCAMP CAM-RP-2009-015 Rev A (2011) Hexcel 8552 IM7 Uni Data Report; NCP-RP-2009-028 Rev B (2019) SAR. Located but not retrievable (network policy).

materials.name: IM7/8552
materials.applicability: Lamina set as used by Camanho et al. (2007) for notched-strength modelling. Mean values, not basis allowables. Do not mix with datasheet values in one analysis.

E1.note: Datasheet 0 deg tensile modulus is 164 GPa (HEX8552); different test basis.
E1.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

E2.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

G12.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

nu12.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

Xt.note: Datasheet 0 deg tensile strength is 2724 MPa (HEX8552).
Xt.verification_note: [ARX2607] lists 2326 MPa (vs 2323.5 stored); primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

Xc.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

Yt.note: UD (unconstrained) value; datasheet 90 deg tensile strength 64 MPa (HEX8552).
Yt.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

Yc.verification_note: [ARX2607] lists 200 MPa (vs 199.8 stored); primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

S12.verification_note: Matches arXiv:2607.07977 Table 1 [ARX2607]; primary [CAM07] not retrieved.

S23.note: Transverse shear strength not in source; Hashin MC uses Yc/2 assumption (flagged).

ILSS.note: Short-beam strength (ASTM D2344) not loaded; interlaminar check uses S12 (flagged).

eps1t.note: Not in source; max strain/LaRC03 use derived Xt/E1 (flagged).

eps1c.note: Not in source; derived Xc/E1 used (flagged).

gamma12u.note: Derived S12/G12 used (flagged); real shear response is non-linear.

GIIc.verification_note: Primary source not retrievable in this environment (network policy); value not confirmed by any accessible source.

t_ply.note: Nominal cured ply thickness at 35 % resin content (datasheet).
t_ply.verification_note: Hexcel 8552 EU datasheet value seen via search extracts (two independent searches); PDF not retrievable.

density.note: Rule of mixtures with fibre 1.78 g/cm3, resin 1.30 g/cm3, Vf 0.577. Verify with ASTM D792 data.

alpha1.note: No traceable value retrieved for this lamina set.
alpha1.verification_note: NOT ENTERED. A Hexcel IM7 fibre datasheet extract lists a 'typical HexPly 8552 composite' CTE of -0.64 ppm/C without direction or test basis; insufficient to populate alpha1/alpha2. Use NCAMP/CMH-17 or test data.

alpha2.note: No traceable value retrieved for this lamina set.

Tg_dry.note: Approximate dry Tg for 8552; confirm with ASTM E1640 data before using hot/wet estimates.

Vf.verification_note: Hexcel 8552 EU datasheet value seen via search extract; PDF not retrievable.
